description: This file implements a class for managing real-time streaming of messages over WebSocket connections, including message storage, logging, and bidirectional message forwarding, specifically tailored for OpenAI-like real-time response handling.

classes.name: RealTimeStreaming
classes.description: A class for managing real-time message streaming, storage, logging, and WebSocket communication for OpenAI-like APIs.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RealTimeStreaming instance with WebSocket connections, logging, configuration, and model info.

methods.name: _should_store_message
methods.description: Determines if a message should be stored based on its type and configured event types.

methods.name: store_message
methods.description: Stores a message after parsing and converting it into appropriate event objects.

methods.name: store_input
methods.description: Stores input message and triggers pre-call logging.

methods.name: backend_to_client_send_messages
methods.description: Receives messages from backend WebSocket, transforms, logs, and forwards them to the client WebSocket.

methods.name: client_ack_messages
methods.description: Receives messages from client WebSocket, logs, transforms, and forwards them to backend WebSocket.

methods.name: bidirectional_forward
methods.description: Runs bidirectional message forwarding between client and backend WebSocket connections.
